en.title: Legal Engineering: Danish community for legal engineering
en.description: A Danish community for legal engineers.

hero.line1: Legal expertise can become working systems.
hero.line2: A Danish community for legal engineers.

who.title: Who we are
who.p1: Legalengineer.dk is a community for lawyers and professionals who want to understand the technology, build concrete solutions and develop the way legal work is produced and delivered.
who.p2: Our members have different backgrounds, but share the wish to raise the bar for legal engineering in Denmark.

da.title: Legal Engineering: Dansk fællesskab for legal engineering
da.description: Et dansk fællesskab for legal engineers.

hero.line1: Juridisk ekspertise kan blive til fungerende systemer.
hero.line2: Et dansk fællesskab for legal engineers.

who.title: Om os
who.p1: Legalengineer.dk er et fællesskab for jurister og fagfolk, som ønsker at forstå teknologien, bygge konkrete løsninger og udvikle den måde, juridisk arbejde produceres og leveres på.
who.p2: Vores medlemmer har forskellige baggrunde, men deler ønsket om at hæve barren for legal engineering i Danmark.
